opening_signature.recognition_cue: A symmetric target or condition uses x+y, xy, a shifted product, or reciprocal pair structure.
opening_signature.representation: Set s=x+y and p=xy; rebuild target from s,p.
opening_signature.first_move: Write s=x+y, p=xy before solving for x,y.
opening_signature.legality_check: If real x,y are required, check s^2-4p >= 0; preserve all branches.

concepts.title: Three-variable symmetry and cyclic method selection

opening_signature.recognition_cue: Three variables appear symmetrically, cyclically, or through repeated xyz.
opening_signature.representation: Choose among s,q,r; p=xyz; or cyclic orientation comparison.
opening_signature.first_move: If xyz repeats in all equations, set p=xyz and rewrite each equation.
opening_signature.legality_check: Record nonzero assumptions for reciprocals; do not treat cyclic expressions as symmetric.

concepts.title: Quadratic root classification and repeated-root geometry

opening_signature.recognition_cue: The statement classifies root count: no two distinct real roots, one root, double root, or tangency.
opening_signature.representation: Use discriminant/root geometry and repeated-root conditions.
opening_signature.first_move: For x^2+ux+v not having two distinct real roots, write u^2-4v <= 0.
opening_signature.legality_check: Include Delta=0 in not-two-distinct; for cubic/quartic repeated roots use f(r)=f'(r)=0 and global count checks.

concepts.title: Polynomial difference, Vieta, and preimage thinking

opening_signature.recognition_cue: Equal polynomial outputs, roots used through symmetric sums, or roots of a composition.
opening_signature.representation: Factor P(x)-P(k), use Vieta, or map preimages under Q.
opening_signature.legality_check: Track integer-root restrictions, multiplicities, and source-QC unresolved items separately.

opening_signature.recognition_cue: Denominator/pole locations are symmetric around one midpoint.
opening_signature.first_move: Write the excluded poles, find midpoint c, then set t=x-c.
opening_signature.legality_check: Before clearing denominators exclude poles; if u=t^2, require u>=0 and excluded u-values.
